title: HUD+
description: HUD + is a lightweight and highly customizable Fabric HUD mod for Minecraft 1.21–1.21.11
body:
HUD+ is a lightweight, modern HUD overhaul for Fabric 1.21.x. It brings together the useful parts of FPS counters, keystrokes mods, armor HUDs, PvP utility overlays, and clean debug-style information into one polished client-side mod.

Designed for everyday survival, PvP, practice servers, and content creation, HUD+ gives you a customizable overlay without needing multiple separate HUD mods.

Features

- FPS counter
- Ping display
- CPS counter
- BPS movement speed
- Coordinates
- Direction display
- Biome display
- Clock
- Armor HUD
- Armor durability
- Item durability
- Potion effects with real Minecraft effect icons
- Totem counter
- Arrow counter
- Keystrokes
- Custom crosshair
- HUD editor opened with Right Shift
- Drag and drop HUD elements
- Resize HUD elements
- Snap to grid
- Live preview
- Auto-saving JSON config
- Themes and opacity/scale controls
  
HUD Editor: 
Press Right Shift in-game to open the HUD editor. From there you can move, resize, reset, and preview HUD elements live.

Compatibility: 
HUD+ is client-side only and built for Fabric.

Supported Minecraft versions:
1.21, 1.21.1, 1.21.2, 1.21.3, 1.21.4, 1.21.5, 1.21.6, 1.21.7, 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11

Compatible with:

1. Fabric API
2. Mod Menu
3. Sodium
4. Iris
 
Requirements: 

1. Fabric Loader
2. Fabric API
3. Java 21+
4. Minecraft 1.21.x
   
Notes: 
HUD + is client-side only. It does not need to be installed on servers.
